entities.summary: Rwanda is a sovereign nation in East Africa, Africa. Its capital is Kigali. Official languages include Kinyarwanda, French, English. Government: Unitary dominant-party presidential republic. Population: approximately 14.4 million. Area: 26,338 km². Comprehensive index for Rwanda covering Kingdom of Rwanda, mwami monarchy, German/Belgian colonial manipulation of Hutu-Tutsi identities, 1959 revolution, 1994 genocide against the Tutsi, RPF victory, Kagame reconstruction, and economic transformation.
